icml.notes: Official ICML logo (head mark + ICML + full name), no year. Sanitized, viewBox trimmed to the artwork. Black #100f0d with red/blue/orange/green squares; the subtitle is illegible at 22 px but ICML reads.

neurips.venue: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
neurips.notes: Mark only: the two purple paths (#68448b, #916ba4) of the official NeurIPS logo; the 'Neural Information Processing Systems' wordmark paths were removed because they are unreadable at 22 px. The neurips.cc navbar logo (mark + 'NeurIPS') sets its word as live <text> in light grey, so it was not used.

iclr.notes: Official ICLR logo (head mark + ICLR wordmark), no year. Slate #35414d text, green/cyan squares. Sanitized, viewBox trimmed.

ieee-sp.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P)
ieee-sp.notes: Trojan-horse head of the IEEE Technical Community on Security and Privacy, the logo the S&P symposium sites use (sp2026.ieee-security.org/images/trojan.png is the same artwork at 109x98; the 500 px copy from the EuroS&P site was used). Wood-brown raster, transparent background, trimmed, resized to 160 px. Identical to eurosp.png.

usenix.notes: USENIX association logo (U roundel + USENIX wordmark), all black. USENIX Security only has year-specific wordmarks (e.g. sec25_wordmark), so the association logo is used.

cvpr.venue: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
cvpr.notes: Year-free CVPR wordmark, single blue #7394c7. Sanitized; viewBox trimmed from a mostly empty 12500x6250 canvas.

eccv.notes: ECCV has no year-free logo (eccv.ecva.net only carries the 'ECCV 2026 | Malmo' skyline logo, illegible at icon size). This is the logo of ECVA, the European Computer Vision Association that runs ECCV: green #67cd84 'ECVA' with a black dot. Trimmed, resized to 128 px tall.

acl.venue: Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL, incl. Findings)
acl.notes: ACL mark, single red #ed1c24, no lettering. Also covers EMNLP and EACL (see aliases).

emnlp.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP, incl. Findings)
emnlp.notes: Alias of acl.svg. EMNLP has no year-free logo: the 2026 logo (2026.emnlp.org) is the ACL mark plus 'EMNLP2026 Budapest', and emnlp.org redirects to sigdat.org.

eacl.venue: Conference of the European Chapter of the ACL (EACL, incl. Findings)
eacl.notes: Alias of acl.svg. eacl.org's own logo (eacl.org/assets/images/eacl-logo.png) is the same red ACL mark; the year logo (EACL 2026 Rabat) carries dates.

acsac.notes: ACSAC emblem (green hooded figure with yellow padlock on a grey disc), no year. Largest official copy found is 192 px; trimmed to 175x170. Colours green #1b8847, yellow #f2b543, grey #a7aea3.

eurosp.venue: IEEE European Symposium on Security and Privacy (EuroS&P)
eurosp.notes: Same Trojan-horse logo (IEEE TC on Security and Privacy) as ieee-sp.png; EuroS&P has no logo of its own. Wood-brown raster, transparent, 160 px.

acm.venue: ACM Workshop on Information Hiding and Multimedia Security (IH&MMSec)
acm.notes: IH&MMSec has no logo of its own; ihmmsec.org shows the ACM logo (cms/upload/2023/acm_logo_rect.png) and a 2026 photo banner. ACM diamond, blues #3792c1/#69b4e0 with white 'acm'. Wikimedia Commons, public domain; metadata removed.

ieee.notes: Wordmark of the magazine itself ('IEEE SECURITY & PRIVACY'), dark red #a2151b block, grey ampersand, black #231f20 text. Same artwork as the JPG the S&P symposium site links to computer.org/csdl/magazine/sp. Wide (about 5:1).
